note: What a server sends to set a side's score, where a match is won on score. The header names no object: it carries zero.

revisions.note: A client takes this only once the match has started. It keeps the score but draws nothing from this message alone: the score shows on the panel that a client shows only where the version answer named the mode ODIN and a point is known (CapturePointChanged). That panel counts five points and a score of 500 at most, both fixed in the client. A score kept before the panel shows is shown when it does. Reaching a score ends nothing in a client: a match ends through the messages that end any match.

fields.name: side
fields.note: Which side, 100 or 200. A client ignores any other.

fields.name: score
fields.note: The score it now stands at: the whole of it, not a change.

fields.name: score
fields.note: The score it now stands at, observed 500.
